blocks.text: Voice-over artist Inka Magnaye rushed to the emergency room after eating a mushroom dish that restaurant staff told her was mushroom-free. She shared the scary ordeal on Facebook. Magnaye said she asked the staff twice if the dish contained mushrooms. Both times, the staff said no. The menu also did not list mushrooms as an ingredient.
